item.title: Bloomington residents clean up after tornado, severe storms
item.description: Severe storms caused extensive damage to Bloomington and surrounding counties, including a Fifth Third Bank, a Kia dealership, and the Monroe County Humane Society, with potential tornado damage reported in the area.

item.title: Pittsburgh edges Notre Dame 73-68 behind Siulepa’s 22 points
item.description: Pittsburgh held off Notre Dame 73-68 on Saturday, with Roman Siulepa scoring 22 points and Nojus Indrusaitis adding a career-high 17, ending a five-game skid.

item.title: Butler edges Xavier 80-75 behind Michael Ajayi’s 24 points
item.description: Michael Ajayi had 24 points and 9 rebounds to lead Butler to an 80-75 win against Xavier on Saturday.

item.title: 20-year-old male shot in Elkhart, police investigate

item.title: Cold weekend snow then a warmer turn midweek | Feb. 21, 2026
item.description: The weekend will be cold with light snow, transitioning to a warmer midweek with rain chances returning and potential for slick roads and potholes.

item.title: Wrong-way driver kills a 20-year-old woman, injuries another, on I-65
item.description: A 20-year-old woman was killed and two other people were seriously injured when a wrong-way driver hit their vehicle head-on on I-65, and the driver is in critical condition and may have been impaired.

item.title: Juvenile male in life-threatening condition after Fort Wayne shooting
item.description: A male juvenile is in life-threatening condition after a shooting on the 7500 block of Tanbark Lane in Fort Wayne Saturday.

item.title: Man dead after shooting on Indy’s east side
item.description: A person was shot on Indy's east side and is in critical condition.

item.title: Three suspects injured in police shooting near 10th and German Church
item.description: Four passengers were taken into custody after an officer-involved shooting near Eastridge Elementary School, with three of them taken to area hospitals with injuries, and no officers or uninvolved community members were injured.

item.title: Former Purdue wide receiver found dead in New Albany
item.description: Rondale Moore, former Purdue University football star and current Minnesota Vikings wide receiver, was found dead in New Albany, Ind. on Saturday, with police investigating the incident as a suspected self-inflicted gunshot wound.
